connector.name: Tinify image tools
connector.registryDescription: Compress, resize, crop, and convert images with the Tinify.dev API from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.tinify, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TINIFY_API_KEY
env.description: Tinify.dev API key (tnf_live_* or tnf_test_*), created at https://tinify.dev/developers. Free tier: 500 operations/month.

env.name: TINIFY_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API origin (advanced; defaults to https://api.tinify.dev).
